description: Search recent public posts where someone asks to hire a freelancer or agency for a service (web design, development, Shopify, WordPress, SEO, ads, video, copywriting, design, social media, virtual assistants and more). Returns the niche, request type, budget if stated, platform, community and age; post links are included after the user signs in with EvenLeads. Covers freelance and agency services only; works without signing in.

hours.description: How far back to look in hours (1-168). Default 48.

niche.description: Optional niche slug, as listed by the niche list.

query.description: The service in plain words, e.g. "shopify developer", "logo design", "seo for dentists".

name: find_hiring_requests
title: Find hiring requests
